- NullPointerException: Thrown if key or value is null and map does not permit nulls. If the underlying map does not allow null values, this exception will occur. Therefore, it is not fully avoided because it depends on the map implementation, which is not explicitly guaranteed to allow nulls.
- IllegalArgumentException: Thrown if some property of key or value prevents storage. No obvious violations; all keys and values appear valid. Avoided.
